thread:
elaine_support: FYI customer PH-9927 reporting sudden spike in 5xx for streaming responses. They say it looks like client disconnects but billing shows gateway 5xx counts.
jordan_csm: Customer says this started after they upgraded their proxy. They see cutoffs at ~10-15s into stream.
elaine_support: Attached logs from customer (sanitized):
```
[client] FIN, ACK -> server: write error: EPIPE
[proxy] upstream read error: unexpected EOF while reading chunked body
[gateway] connection closed unexpectedly, classify=5xx
```
sam_engineer: Can you paste their curl command or client snippet? chunked encoding + half-close races are common.
jordan_csm: They reproduced with this: `curl -v -N -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" --data-binary @- https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream` then ctrl-c after ~12s.
trent_sre: Refs: we recently tightened proxy read timeouts in release 2026.02.05. Could be a keepalive/halfclose interaction.
ops_bot: [alert] spike: streaming-5xx-rate +430% from eu-west-1 at 2026-02-20T14:12:08Z
sam_engineer: Quick repro I ran against staging shows two failure modes: ECONNRESET from client abort -> gateway logs show upstream aborted read -> our heuristic marks as 502.
sam_engineer: Example staging log snippet: `upstream response truncated: received FIN before terminating chunked trailer; http_status=502`
elaine_support: Customer insists those shouldn't be billed as 5xx since their client aborted. They want credits for the timeframe.
trent_sre: We need to 1) reproduce deterministically, 2) determine classification rule, 3) consider metric/alert change.
sam_engineer: Repro steps I used: `python -c "import requests,sys; r = requests.post('https://staging.api', data=iter(['data\n']*100), headers={'Transfer-Encoding':'chunked'}, stream=True); time.sleep(12); sys.exit(0)` -> staging logs show `read: connection reset by peer` and we count as 502.
elaine_support: Customer also provided a pcap showing TCP FIN from client then server sent RST a moment later.
trent_sre: That suggests client half-close then proxy sees half-closed socket and triggers upstream abort. We should differentiate: client-initiated abort vs server-side error. Right now our pipeline punts to 5xx when upstream stream ends before end-of-chunked-trailer.
sam_engineer: Proposed short-term: change classification to mark client TCP FIN events within X ms as client abort (non-5xx) for billing, while continuing to alert on overall error rate.
jordan_csm: Customer wants retro credits for last 24h. Ops, what's the impact?
trent_sre: I'll run a query on logs: `select count(*) from gateway_logs where reason='unexpected EOF' and region='eu-west-1' and timestamp > now()-24h` to estimate. If many are client-aborts we can propose credits.
sam_engineer: Also found a weird proxy behavior: when the upstream keeps the connection open but the client closes, some proxy versions generate a downstream 502 and close socket with RST instead of graceful pass-through. That's buggy.
deploy_bot: Deploy 2026.02.05 -> proxy v2.14.3 applied to eu-west-1 at 2026-02-05T03:12:00Z
trent_sre: Action items:
- triage->eng: reproduce & confirm minimal repro (sam)
- triage->sre: run counts and flag impacted accounts (trent)
- support: hold comms and offer to pause billing while we investigate (elaine)
elaine_support: Customer assigned ticket owner, will notify once we have repro.
sam_engineer: Quick note: here's a small repro curl that flips behavior depending on proxy: `printf '4\r\nWiki\r\n0\r\n\r\n' | curl -v -N -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" --data-binary @- https://staging.api/stream && sleep 1` then ctrl-C after the first chunk. On proxy v2.14.3 it yields `502` in gateway logs; on older proxy it logs client abort and we don't count 5xx.
trent_sre: I'll gather the log query results and post a summary in 30m. If it's a proxy regression we'll plan a rollback or patch.
jordan_csm: Thanks, please escalate if pattern affects other regions. Customer is sensitive to billed errors.
elaine_support: Also escalating pricing hold to billing for manual review if needed.
ops_bot: [note] incident created: INC-2026-042 streaming-client-abort-miscount, priority=P2
sam_engineer: Follow-up: added an integration test for chunked half-close to the infra e2e harness. Pushed a branch with logs attached.
trent_sre: Summary after queries: ~820 events in last 24h in eu-west-1, ~75% co-occur with client FIN in pcap traces we sampled. Recommend: 1) patch classification rule 2) issue credits for affected customers 3) rollback proxy change if patch not ready in 24h.
elaine_support: I'll draft an email for impacted customers offering credits and ETA.
jordan_csm: Customer reaction: "thanks, we just need the billing fixed and a root cause plan"
sam_engineer: Will open PR for heuristic change and link to this thread.
trent_sre: Closing loop: will post rollback decision tomorrow at 09:00 UTC if no patch by then.
elaine_support: Thanks everyone.
deploy_bot: [deploy-note] rollback window scheduled for proxy v2.14.3 in eu-west-1: 2026-02-21T09:00:00Z
sam_engineer: I'll attach the test logs and the proposed change set in the PR.
elaine_support: Marking ticket PH-9927 as escalated to SRE/Engineering.
jordan_csm: keep me updated :) :thumbsup:
